title: Remantoka: Crimson Clean
description: A clean red PvP-style pack with sharp items, warm block tones, and a custom Crimson Remantoka theme.
body:
Crimson Clean is a 16x red-themed PvP resource pack built for a clean, sharp, and readable gameplay look.

Features:
- Red-accented swords, tools, bow, and fishing rod
- Custom hotbar, crosshair, particles, and pack icon
- Warm block tones with fixed sand, stone, ores, and clay textures
- Clean item rendering with no unwanted transparency
- Based on a skinny-style layout, customized into its own Crimson Remantoka theme

Credits:
Created by jhonysins with help from koptaman.
